Subject: Fintech Summit — inference needs & next steps

Hi Sarah —

Great meeting you at the Fintech Summit last week. Really enjoyed hearing about FintechX's roadmap for real-time risk scoring and customer support triage. Quick recap from our chat: 

- Key constraints: sub-50ms tail latency for realtime scoring, multi-tenant isolation for production, and strong audit logs for compliance.
- Workloads: short sequences for scoring + longer ticket summarization tasks.
- Interest areas: Dedicated capacity for predictable p99s, private deployment (VPC) for data controls, and cost/latency tradeoffs for mixed workloads.

I've attached a short one-pager on our Dedicated offering and typical infra patterns for financial customers (Attachment: redwood-dedicated-onepager.pdf). If it's useful, I'd love to set up a quick 30-min discovery to map your exact latency SLOs and traffic profile so we can surface an apples-to-apples estimate and architecture.

Three proposed times (PST):
- Tue 11/18, 10:00–10:30am
- Wed 11/19, 2:00–2:30pm
- Thu 11/20, 11:00–11:30am

Or grab a slot directly on my calendar: https://calendly.com/marissa-redwood/30min

If you prefer, I can loop in Camila (solutions engineering) to prepare a short eval plan.

Thanks — hope the rest of the conference treated you well.

Best,
Marissa Cole
